avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce immune tolerance and reduce monoclonal antibody efficacy through cytochrome P450 modulation affecting immune cell function
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; discuss with oncologist before use

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Immune stimulant may interfere with therapeutic antibody mechanisms and potentially increase infusion-related reactions
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use during active sacituzumab therapy; discuss timing with healthcare provider

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin E (high-dose >400 IU)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have anticoagulant properties; sacituzumab carries thrombocytopenia risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor platelet counts; use standard dosing only if needed

caution_supplements.name: Curcumin/Turmeric
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential immune modulation; limited evidence for interaction but may affect immune tolerance
caution_supplements.action: Inform oncologist of use; monitor for therapeutic efficacy

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: No direct CYP450 interaction with sacituzumab, but may affect concomitant medications metabolized by CYP3A4
caution_foods.action: Limit intake if concurrent medications present; not a primary concern for sacituzumab alone

monitoring_notes: Sacituzumab is a monoclonal antibody with no significant hepatic metabolism; interactions are primarily immunologic rather than pharmacokinetic. Monitor for infusion-related reactions, thrombocytopenia, and neutropenia; avoid immunostimulant supplements that may compromise therapeutic efficacy.
